gloss: to take measures; to strike a deal; to clap hands

definitions.gloss: to take measures; to take action; to do something about
definitions.explanation: To take steps or countermeasures to address a problem or situation.

definitions.gloss: to strike a deal; to reach an agreement; to settle
definitions.explanation: To come to terms or reach a mutually acceptable agreement, often in negotiations.
The literal meaning - to clap one's hands, as in applause or to get attention.

examples.japanese: ⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手|て}を{打|う}った。
⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手|て}を{打|う}た⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: We must take measures before the damage spreads.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なん}らか→何らか：18430_nanraka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手|て}を{打|う}たない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さらに⟦{悪化|あっか}する→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧だろう。

notes:
IDIOM STRUCTURE:
⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + ⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ (to strike/hit)

MULTIPLE MEANINGS:
This expression has distinct meanings based on context:

1. TAKE MEASURES:
- {手|て}を{打|う}つ - to take action/countermeasures
- ⟦{先手|せんて}を{打|う}つ→先手を打つ：18391_sentewoutsu⟧ - to make the first move
- ⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手|て}を{打|う}つ - to take early action

2. STRIKE A DEAL:
Originates from the custom of clapping hands together to seal an agreement.
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|へん}→辺：00937_hen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{手|て}を{打|う}つ - to settle around here
- {手|て}を{打|う}って⟦{合意|ごうい}→合意：05093_goui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to reach a handshake agreement

3. CLAP HANDS (literal):
- {手|て}を{打|う}って⟦{喜|よろこ}ぶ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧ - to clap hands in joy
- {三三七拍子|さんさんななびょうし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{手|て}を{打|う}つ - to clap in 3-3-7 rhythm

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手|て}を{打|う}つ - to take countermeasures
- ⟦{何|なん}らか→何らか：18430_nanraka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手|て}を{打|う}つ - to take some kind of action
- ⟦{適切|てきせつ}→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧な{手|て}を{打|う}つ - to take appropriate measures

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in business and everyday contexts.
